criteria.photon_materials: Photon and Faithful preserve the brick/oak split; the controller brick blends with the plinth while copper, leather and iron details remain readable without emissive metal.
criteria.scale_readability: At normal world distance the low vat is clearly distinct from the taller Smithy and lighter Textile Workshop; the drying rack remains legible against the sky.
criteria.states_motion: The static assembly remains coherent while the existing controller fire/working state changes independently.
criteria.interaction_guides: The focused workshop scene assembles the real Part list and verifies completion; all partial pieces use the existing contextual guide and placement system.
criteria.inventory_appearance: The existing controller item model inherits the redesigned block model and front texture; no item-specific transform changed.
criteria.integration_limits: Reviewed under the recommended Photon shader with Faithful 32x. The scene verifies the assembled front/side silhouette and controller UI; rear construction is represented by the same supported rack seen in the context view.
